*   **Team & Budget Updates:** Rebecca announced the expansion of the team with Mike Chen (machine learning) and Lisa Ray (cloud computing). Carla reported the compliance plan budget was increased to $55,000. Jane Doe confirmed a $15,000 budget approval for specialized training starting next month.
